mainText: <speak><voice name="Kendra">Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies and a lovely full moon tonight near the Military Ridge State Trail.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Matthew">The city is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for students to get involved in the local election process, and the Senior Center has updated their tri-shaw program waiver which requires a witness for all participants.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Joey">There is plenty to do with trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga and the downtown farmer's market tomorrow.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Kimberly">In a noteworthy call from July 23, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Lucerne Drive where a 23-year-old man was arrested for disorderly conduct and O W I related charges were not involved in that specific incident.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joanna">Today's flavor is Georgia Peach, but since the store is currently closed, head over when they open at 10:00 AM. Tomorrow you can look forward to Caramel Peanut Buttercup.</voice></speak>
